featured_reviews.review_text:
In early 2026, during a small thanksgiving gathering with office colleagues, I took a moment to acknowledge my journey and express gratitude to a few people who made 2025 particularly meaningful for me. Among them, I especially mentioned Dr. Nikita Chavan for her consistent care and support throughout my recovery.
On 11th September 2024, I began my first day at Evolution of Movement (EOM), Colaba, about 45 days after a herniated slip disc injury at the L5-S1 region. The recovery initially felt slow and uncertain, but gradually I understood that healing is not immediate—it is a step-by-step process that requires patience, consistency, and trust.
A close family friend had recommended EOM and Dr. Chavan, describing her as skilled, attentive, and confident in her approach. I decided to visit, and she warmly received me for consultation.
That first morning, walking to the centre felt like a quiet step toward recovery. The environment at EOM was calm and reassuring—very different from a conventional clinical setup.
When I met Dr. Chavan, she reviewed my reports and examined the injury with calm clarity. She assured me that full recovery was possible, though it would take time and disciplined effort.
The initial sessions were not easy. Even simple movements felt difficult due to stiffness and a lack of confidence after the injury. But her approach was always steady, realistic, and compassionate, which made a significant difference.
Over time, I began to trust both the process and the guidance. It became a journey of slowly rebuilding strength, awareness, and confidence.
Today, looking back, it has been almost two years under her care at EOM, starting from that initial injury. The journey has been steady and well-supported.
Currently, I am focusing on overall strength building across the body to maintain long-term fitness and stability.
Heartfelt thanks to Dr. Nikita Chavan and the EOM for  my recovery journey after my injury and helping me regain strength and confidence.

featured_reviews.name: Rajeev Jaiswal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great place. Bhagyashree is too good.

Abha, Sid and Bhagyashree bring the vibes, and they connect so well with the participants.

Don't miss it, if you want to loose 400-500 cals an hour without stressing your body. I feel fresh day long after the workout.

featured_reviews.name: Joshi Deepak
featured_reviews.review_text:
I do not know about the dance and other activities in this classes . But  they play music so loud the other shops and passing by people get irritated even their shop door gets vibrated due to such high bass. they can easily make that door sound proof.
And also such loud music can cause problem in hearing power for the kids and adults attending these classes.
There are other music and dance classes next to them but the sound from them are with in limits.and also there are some child clinic .
requsting to owners please either reduce the volume or  make your class sound proof.

featured_reviews.name: Rajneet Kaur
featured_reviews.review_text: Fun filled dance classes, bolly Zumba makes my day go live !

featured_reviews.name: Rosemary Alphonso
featured_reviews.review_text:
Superb place for Zumba classes.

The owner, Abha ma’am, is very professional, considerate and kind. I enjoy going for these classes led by Sid Sir. He is a great instructor, polite and highly energetic.

The place has a lot of positive vibes and I always look forward to attending Zumba classes here.

featured_reviews.name: preeti gour
featured_reviews.review_text: I am attending Zumba classes here currently. The experience so far has been great. All the instructors are really good and experienced. Best place in Thane for learning dance and many other fitness activities. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Vibha Bhola
featured_reviews.review_text: I have joined Zumba classes at vibe zone about 2weeks back and the experience has been great! The instructor Siddharth sir is extremely polite, professional and full of energy! I would highly recommend to join the vibe zone for fitness and dance!

featured_reviews.name: suraj gouri
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great team and instructor 👍👍. Had enquired for my friend and found the owner and instructor both very professional and polite. They also have adjustable batch timings.
Would definitely recommend for the crowd out there looking for geniune dance or zumba classes.
Kudos👏 for the team.

featured_reviews.name: Akshey Goyal
featured_reviews.review_text: I love this dance studio! The teachers are awesome, and they have classes for everyone. The place is nice, and I've learned a lot. It's fun and friendly – I feel like I'm part of a group. I really think you should try it!
